text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, mind if I drop by my part-time job on the way?
It's right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Ines Fujin's part-time job managers, Daitaku Helios, and Mejiro Palmer were all gathered there.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? I-It's nothing at all!?
Just, you know—... right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We're looking for part-time gigs!
Right, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah... T-Totally, right~~?!
Like, getting introduced to the manager got me super hyped?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it.
Kind of like... a joint company information session?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll help out too!
I am working part-time here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: For example...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A ramen shop's main duties are...
taking orders, serving food, and cleaning up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Also, the trick to greeting people is delivering the end of your sentences crisply!
Let's see~, picturing our Chairwoman should give you a good feel for it♪

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, Fuu's callouts are on another level!
Some people even place extra orders
just to hear her energetic voice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Convenience store work is mainly stocking shelves and cashiering.
As long as you're not bad with customer service, you'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Plus, I get to talk with all sorts of customers, and I think it'll be a great way to connect with the locals!"

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
People even form long lines just because they want a chance to interact with you.
You ought to take more pride in that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on, Store Manager!?
Why does this sound like an introduction of me now!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, rather than the work itself,
they seemed to be praising Ines Fujin's work ethic the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And one more thing... It's early morning work,
so maybe they haven't arrived yet?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I also recommend my long-term gig handing out flyers!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "Whoaa~!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were juggling a bunch of jobs, but
you really are super capable, huh~!!
Man, I gotta hand it to you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: U-Um? Surely that's going a bit too far—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: “Still... maybe not! Yup, yup!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I might just be a hyper part-timer!
So... everyone, bow down and worship me!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
To start off,
how about calling me Ines "Senpai"~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, just kidding, just kidding! But—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you two are coming to work part-time, I'll properly back you up as your senior.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want it to be a good experience for them,
and I also want it to help out the manager and staff.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to turn you into a fully-fledged pro!
choice_data_list: As expected of a Hyper Part-Timer.
As expected of a Hyper Part-Timer.
I'm starting to get interested too~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to turn you into a fully-fledged pro!
choice_data_list: As expected of a Hyper Part-Timer.
As expected of a Hyper Part-Timer.
I'm starting to get interested too~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, of course!
I haven't been working part-time for this long for nothing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just how many people do you think I've whipped into shape up until now~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, look at the time!
I've got my next part-time job!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Trainer, want to work part-time too?
You're pretty handy, so that might actually be a big help~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no!
You're already so busy, you can't take on another job!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With everything, doing it without pushing yourself too hard is best♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, look at the time!
I've got my next part-time job!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, good luck to both of you!
See you later, Trainer~!"
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll be taking my leave too...
Well then, I'll be taking my leave too...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wait a minuute!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Actually, Trainer,
there's something important I wanted to discuss with you—
